The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already open in Jamovi. You need to verify the 'Homogeneity of Regression Slopes' assumption for an ANCOVA predicting 'Exam' scores from 'Anxiety' (covariate) and 'Gender' (grouping factor).

1. Create a Scatterplot (under Exploration > Scatterplot or Regression > Linear Regression > Plots) with 'Anxiety' on the X-axis, 'Exam' on the Y-axis, and 'Gender' as the Group/Split variable. Add 'Regression Lines' to visually inspect if slopes are parallel.

2. Formally test the assumption by running a Linear Regression. Set 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable, and add both 'Anxiety' and 'Gender' to the model. IMPORTANT: In the 'Model Builder' section, select both variables and add them as an INTERACTION term ('Anxiety ✻ Gender') to the model.

3. Save the Jamovi project to '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/HomogeneityCheck.omv'.

4. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/assumption_report.txt' containing the unstandardized coefficient (B) and p-value for the interaction term, and your conclusion (Assumption Met/Violated). Use this exact format:
Interaction_B=<value>
Interaction_p=<value>
Conclusion=<Met or Violated>
